title: Casting the restricted weight observation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $S\subseteq J$. For any fixed sign assignment $z$ on the coordinates outside $J$ and any two sign assignments $y,y'$ on $J$, the rational observation formed from the labels $f(y,z)$ and $f(y',z)$ and their respective lifted Fourier observations, regarded as a real number, equals the product of the two corresponding real restricted Fourier coefficient observations.
hypotheses_covered: A sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
A sign assignment $z$ on coordinates outside $J$
